prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one exploratory square high-resolution app icon for Make Something Worthwhile, an educational combination game about discovering how things work by making things. A single striking icon, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no mockup, no comparison grid. Large central emblem with comfortable outer margins, carefully designed for recognition at 256px and with a silhouette and major colour masses that remain strong at favicon scale. Sophisticated, inviting, tactile, curious; never babyish. This is a new original design. Subject: a beautiful palm-sized circular mosaic medallion viewed directly from above. A radiant warm gold sun at its centre, broad ivory rays curving gently outward through rich deep teal and midnight blue fields. All the surfaces are physically assembled from large irregular cut ceramic and gold-glass tesserae, about 28 to 40 visible pieces TOTAL in the whole medallion; boldly simplified mosaic with no hundreds of tiny tiles. Broad golden centre and only six broad rays dominate the composition. Thin warm charcoal grout, subtle tactile differences between matte ivory ceramic, deep translucent blue glass and luminous gold leaf under glass. The outer circular edge is slightly irregular, crafted rather than mechanically perfect. Beautiful material variation visible at large size, simple gold/ivory sun against teal legible when tiny. The whole circular icon occupies 84% of the square, isolated against genuinely transparent surroundings. No table, tools, scattered pieces, scenery, floral stems, extra border rings or cast shadow outside the emblem. Use the material charm of hand-laid architectural mosaics, direct diffuse light, almost flat top-down presentation.
